note: RFC 1334 Section 2.2.2: "If the Peer-ID/Password pair received in an Authenticate-Request is both recognizable and acceptable, then the authenticator MUST transmit a PAP packet with the Code field set to 2 (Authenticate-Ack)." Rejudged after 83deb89129; the only tagged-unit change for this row is the added proto assertion in the negative and corrected pap.go line references. TestPAPRequestEmitsEvent delivers accept through the real runPAPAuthPhase over a pipe and asserts ProtoPAP, PAPAuthenticateAck and a true return. TestPAPRejectWritesNak asserts ProtoPAP and PAPAuthenticateNak on reject, so an unconditional Ack goes red; the recorded mutant inverts the branch at pap.go:258. Acceptance itself is the handler's decision, delivered on authRespCh; this row proves the reply to that decision. Caveat on proof: the tagged units compare the symbolic constant, and the literal Code 2 is pinned by the untagged TestPAPWriteAck (0x02); the positive record panics WritePAPAck rather than changing the Code. The sentence is in Section 2.2.2; RFC 1334 has no Section 2.3.
